title: wb init --apply rewrites boards it does not print on its wrote: lines
body: Found in the 3.3.0 estate sweep (ST0092 WP-11), 2026-11-11. On a board at intent/board@4.0, intent wb init --apply re-renders every seat's board.json to intent/board@4.1 but names only the files it changed for the profile on wrote: lines, and prints the rest as re-rendered: or not at all. A commit of exactly what the verb printed leaves the schema line dirty on the other boards, which then needs a second mechanical commit (Conflab, Lamplight, cordee-papillon, Devbin, Webber). The verb should name every file it wrote.
